## Nature in Tierra del Fuego

Tierra del Fuego National Park lies near Ushuaia and protects landscapes where the mountains reach the sea. Forests, peat bogs and glacial lakes sit side by side here. Views of the water appear between the trees, while peaks rise above the valleys. This is the kind of journey that invites frequent stops: each turn in the road or trail reveals different details.

The park is remarkable for its combination of coastal and mountain scenery. Well-known places include Lapataia Bay and Lake Acigami, which give a sense of the variety of landscapes within the park. You can watch birds along the shore and look closely at the trunks and low-growing vegetation in the forest. The specific areas visited depend on the excursion route.

Tierra del Fuego will appeal to travelers who enjoy cool air and vast natural spaces. Bring warm clothing and an outer layer that protects against wind and rain. Weather changes quickly in southern Patagonia, and being comfortably dressed makes it much easier to take in the scenery at leisure.

## Excursion Terms

The excursion costs $76 per person.

Discounts may be available for more than one person; contact us to discuss.
